updates.title: Google Tests Video Ads Inside Local Pack Search Results
updates.summary: Google is testing video ads that appear directly in local pack results, wired through Google Ads Location Manager. For high intent location queries like near me, restaurants, or services, video adds an immersive layer map results have never had before.
updates.action: If you run Local campaigns or Performance Max for store goals, start producing short vertical video now so you can opt in when the test expands. Best hooks: 3-second store exterior, live staff shot, signature product close up.

updates.title: Google Ads Asset Studio Speeds Up Creative but Shifts Work to PPC Managers
updates.summary: Google Ads Asset Studio now generates images and videos inside the platform with AI, removing the budget barrier to short-form video. But reviewers report limited creative control and more production responsibility landing on paid search managers instead of creative teams.
updates.action: Use Asset Studio for fast message and voiceover tests before committing to full production. Plan for the governance gap: Asset Studio does not flag AI content, so build your own disclosure process before New York's synthetic performer law hits in June 2026.

updates.title: Google Clarifies Election Ads Are Exempt From YouTube and Discover Placement Requirements
updates.summary: Google updated documentation to confirm that election ads are exempt from the standard YouTube and Discover Feed ad requirements while still bound by broader Google Ads policies. This is a clarification, not a new rule.
updates.action: If you run election or political campaigns in a region Google supports, make sure Election Ads verification is current. Other advertisers: no action needed, but useful to know for regulated-industry client questions.

updates.title: CNIL Publishes Final Rules on Email Tracking Pixels with 3-Month Transition
updates.summary: France's CNIL adopted binding guidance on email tracking pixels. Open-rate tracking, campaign optimization pixels, and audience profiling now require explicit opt-in consent. Only basic deliverability tracking like last-open date is permitted without consent.
updates.action: If you email French or EU recipients, audit your ESP setup now. Add one-click unsubscribe or consent-withdrawal links in every email footer. Three-month transition means cleanup by mid-June 2026.

updates.title: 87 Percent of Agency Pros Say the Traditional Agency Model Is Broken
updates.summary: A Basis survey of 213 advertising professionals found 87.3 percent believe the traditional agency model is broken today or will be within 3-5 years. Among senior leaders the figure rises to 91.5 percent. Drivers: AI adoption, martech stack complexity, and client in-housing.
updates.action: If you are pricing agency retainers, stress test the model against AI automation of reporting, pulls, and creative. The edge going forward is strategy, execution velocity, and proprietary data not headcount hours.

updates.title: Google Will Retire Dynamic Search Ads, ACA, and Campaign-Level Broad Match for AI Max
updates.summary: Google is sunsetting Dynamic Search Ads, Automatically Created Assets, and campaign-level broad match. From September 2026, eligible Search campaigns auto-migrate to AI Max. Google claims a 7 percent average conversion lift at similar efficiency.
updates.action: Migrate DSA, ACA, and broad match campaigns to AI Max voluntarily before September. Test search term matching, text customization, and final URL expansion during the voluntary phase so you keep control before forced migration.

updates.title: Google Ads API to Require Multi-Factor Authentication from April 21
updates.summary: Google is mandating MFA for Google Ads API users starting April 21, 2026. New OAuth 2.0 refresh token generation needs a second verification factor. Existing tokens keep working, and service account workflows are exempt.
updates.action: Enable 2-step verification on all developer accounts now. For automated or offline agency tooling, consider moving to service account workflows. Also affects Google Ads Editor, Scripts, BigQuery Data Transfer, and Data Studio.

updates.title: Google Ads Tests Direct Google Tag Manager Integration for Conversion Setup
updates.summary: Google is testing a conversion setup flow that pushes conversion tracking directly into Google Tag Manager, removing the manual copy and paste of IDs. Fewer handoffs should mean fewer implementation errors for new conversion actions.
updates.action: Watch for a Set up in Google Tag Manager option inside your conversion setup flow. Once it appears, use it for new conversions. Also audit existing conversions for manual setup errors you can clean up when the integration goes broad.

updates.title: Meta Launches Muse Spark Shopping Experience That Pulls from Creators and Brand Content
updates.summary: Meta introduced a new AI shopping experience built on its Muse Spark model. It recommends outfits, home styling, and gift ideas by pulling from creator content and brand storytelling already on Instagram and Facebook. Live on the Meta AI app now and rolling out on IG and FB.
updates.action: If you sell on IG or FB, make sure your brand storytelling and creator partnerships are rich and well tagged. Muse Spark cites owned and earned content you already have, so thin or off-brand posts will be missed. Check Partnership Ads hub for creator content to amplify.

updates.title: TikTok Adds Dreamina Seedance 2.0 AI Video Generation to Symphony
updates.summary: TikTok plugged ByteDance's Dreamina Seedance 2.0 into Symphony, its ad creation toolkit. The model generates realistic video from text prompts with improved product consistency and more natural motion. Previously available in CapCut.
updates.action: Test Dreamina output against your current UGC and stock-footage variants. Watch for uncanny valley and product inaccuracies before spending on it. Best use right now is scaling B-roll and concept tests, not replacing creator-led hooks.

updates.title: LinkedIn Expands AI Conversational Search Sitewide
updates.summary: LinkedIn rolled out AI powered conversational search to all users, after a Premium only preview. The new search understands natural language, nickname variations, and spelling tolerance, and shows AI summaries explaining why each member appears.
updates.action: Update your own and clients' LinkedIn profiles and company pages with specific keywords, job titles, and industry terms that match how buyers describe the problem. Verification badges and complete profiles surface higher, so close those gaps.

updates.title: OpenAI Starts Rolling Out Ads to Free and Go Users in Australia, New Zealand, Canada
updates.summary: OpenAI expanded its ad monetization to free and lower-tier Go users in Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. Premium tiers stay ad free. The format inside conversational AI is still being defined, and agencies are in early test mode.
updates.action: If you sell in ANZ or Canada, get on the early access list so you learn placement mechanics before competitors. Keep budgets small, and focus on high intent audiences. Measurement is still thin, so treat spend as learning investment.

updates.title: AI-Referred Traffic Now Converts 42 Percent Better Than Non-AI for US Retailers
updates.summary: New Adobe data shows AI referral traffic to US retail sites grew 393 percent year over year in Q1 2026. In March, AI driven visits converted 42 percent better than non AI traffic, a full reversal from a year ago when AI traffic was 38 percent less likely to convert.
updates.action: Audit your PLP and PDP content for machine readability. Structured data, clear product attributes, and concise FAQs are what AI agents cite. Track ai.com, chatgpt.com, and perplexity.ai referrals in GA4 as a first party signal of AI channel lift.

updates.title: March 2026 Google Core Update Hits 79 Percent of Top-3 Results, Favors Primary Sources
updates.summary: Search Engine Land data on the March 2026 core update shows 79.5 percent of top-3 URLs changed position, up from 66.8 percent in December. Winners were official sites, specialist platforms, government domains, and employer pages. Losers were aggregators, directories, and broad discovery platforms including YouTube.
updates.action: Audit SEO clients against the aggregator vs primary source split. Consolidate owned data, push expertise signals, and reduce reliance on third party aggregation pages. Brands with Knowledge Panels and authored content gained the most.

updates.title: Google Launches Ads Advisor and Analytics Advisor (Agentic AI Tools)
updates.summary: Google introduced two AI agents: Ads Advisor proactively manages campaigns, generates keywords and assets from your website context. Analytics Advisor acts as your data analyst, surfacing insights and guiding measurement decisions.
updates.action: Try Ads Advisor for keyword and asset suggestions. Use Analytics Advisor to identify measurement gaps. Available in all English-language accounts.

updates.title: LinkedIn Reserved Ads, AI Ad Variants, and Dynamic Personalization
updates.summary: LinkedIn launched Reserved Ads for guaranteed top-of-feed placement, AI Ad Variants that generate multiple versions from one input, and dynamic ad personalization using profile data (name, job title). Flexible Ad Creation rolling out in early 2026.
updates.action: Test Reserved Ads for high-priority B2B campaigns. Use AI Ad Variants to quickly A/B test messaging at scale.

updates.title: Meta Will Use AI Chat Data for Ad Targeting
updates.summary: Meta updated its privacy policy to use data from user interactions with Meta AI for targeted ads across Facebook, Instagram, and Threads. This gives Meta a new signal layer from AI conversations.
updates.action: Expect richer AI-driven audience signals. No action needed from advertisers, but be aware users may push back publicly.

updates.title: TikTok Ownership Uncertainty: Marketers Brace for 2026 Whiplash
updates.summary: Following the US TikTok ban scare and sale process, marketers entered 2026 cautious about committing ad budgets. Many diversified spend to Reels and YouTube Shorts as contingency.
updates.action: Maintain diversified short-video strategy across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Do not over-concentrate budget on any single platform.

updates.title: Partnership Ads Hub: Auto-Surface UGC, Affiliate, and Creator Posts
updates.summary: Meta's Partnership Ads Hub now automatically surfaces Instagram UGC, affiliate content, and creator posts that mention your brand. Professional Mode profiles are eligible, and creators can share ad codes instantly.
updates.action: Check Partnership Ads Hub in Ads Manager. Look for organic creator content you can amplify as paid ads.

updates.title: Threads Ads Launch Globally with 400M+ Monthly Users
updates.summary: Ads on Threads launched globally on January 21, 2026. With 400+ million monthly active users, Threads is now a viable placement for both Advantage+ and manual campaigns.
updates.action: Test Threads as a placement in your existing campaigns. Monitor CPM and engagement rates vs Instagram/Facebook placements.

updates.title: Google Opens Ads for Prediction Markets (CFTC-Regulated Only)
updates.summary: Google now permits ads for prediction markets in the US, but only for entities regulated by the CFTC or authorized by the NFA. Effective January 21.
updates.action: Only relevant if you operate a regulated prediction market. All others remain blocked.

updates.title: Call-Only Ads: No New Creation, Full Phase-Out by Feb 2027
updates.summary: Google removed the ability to create new call-only ads. Existing call-only ads continue serving until February 2027 when they stop receiving impressions entirely.
updates.action: Migrate all call-only ads to responsive search ads with call assets now.

updates.title: Google Ads API v23: Channel-Level Reporting for PMax
updates.summary: API v23 released January 28. Introduces channel-level reporting for PMax showing spend distribution across Search, YouTube, Display, Gmail, Discover, and Maps. PMax is no longer a black box.
updates.action: Update your tools to API v23. Pull channel-level reports to see where PMax is spending. Old API v19 stopped working Feb 11.

updates.title: Account-Level Placement Exclusions Activated Across All Campaign Types
updates.summary: Google activated account-level placement exclusions that apply simultaneously across PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Display. No more replicating exclusion lists per campaign.
updates.action: Set up account-level placement exclusions for known low-quality sites. One list now covers all campaign types.

updates.title: Meta: 2026 is the Year AI Drives Performance
updates.summary: Meta published its 2026 vision: AI will drive ad performance through Andromeda (creative-based targeting), Advantage+ automation as default for all objectives, and AI creative tools at scale.
updates.action: Shift creative production to feed Andromeda. Consolidate campaigns into Advantage+. Test AI creative tools (backgrounds, video gen).

updates.title: Universal Music Group Pulls All Tracks from TikTok
updates.summary: UMG removed its entire catalog from TikTok as of February 1 after failing to reach a licensing agreement. This affects any ads using UMG-licensed music.
updates.action: Audit your TikTok ad creative for UMG tracks. Replace with royalty-free or licensed alternatives from TikTok's Commercial Music Library.

updates.title: PMax Channel-Level Reporting Goes Live + Meridian Scenario Planner
updates.summary: PMax channel reporting is now live in the UI (not just API). Separately, Google expanded Meridian with Scenario Planner - a no-code tool to test budget scenarios and view projected ROI in real time.
updates.action: Check PMax channel reports in the UI. Test Meridian Scenario Planner for cross-channel budget planning.

updates.title: Parked Domains Permanently Removed from Search Partner Network
updates.summary: On February 10, Google permanently removed parked domains (AdSense for Domains) from the Search Partner Network. One of the most criticized low-quality inventory sources is gone.
updates.action: Re-evaluate Search Partners performance now that parked domains are removed. Still default to opt-out unless data proves otherwise.

updates.title: Graph API v25.0: Unified Advantage+ API, Old ASC/AAC Deprecated
updates.summary: Graph API v25.0 launched Feb 18 with enhanced async error reporting. Old ASC and AAC APIs are deprecated - all campaigns must migrate to the unified Advantage+ campaign API.
updates.action: If using Meta Marketing API, migrate from ASC/AAC endpoints to unified Advantage+ API before deprecation deadline.

updates.title: Ad Sequencing Rolls Out to Auction Campaigns (14-17x Conversion Lift)
updates.summary: Ad sequencing is no longer reservation-only. Now available for auction campaigns. Early data shows 14-17x conversion lift for controlled 2-3 ad sequences.
updates.action: Test 2-3 ad sequences in auction campaigns. Story arc: problem > solution > proof.

updates.title: HubSpot 2026: Search Is No Longer the Starting Point for Buyer Journeys
updates.summary: HubSpot State of Marketing 2026 (1,500+ marketers) found buyers now move through AI tools, social, creator content, communities, and review sites before reaching a brand website.
updates.action: Map your buyer journey across AI tools, social, review sites, and communities. Invest in presence beyond search.

updates.title: Meta Shifts to Outcome-Based Optimization: Performance Drops Expected
updates.summary: In the first week of March, Meta moved from auction-based placement optimization to outcome-based optimization. The system now predicts downstream conversions rather than optimizing for engagement.
updates.action: Give campaigns 7-10 days before making changes. Compare against CRM data, not platform numbers.

updates.title: PMax Gets Auto AI Voice-Overs on Video Ads (Opt-Out by Mar 20)
updates.summary: Google is auto-enrolling advertisers into an AI voice-over program for PMax video ads. Ads without existing audio get voice enhancement automatically unless you opt out.
updates.action: Check PMax video ads. Opt out before March 20 if you do not want AI voice-overs.

updates.title: Meta Location Fees: Ad Prices Rise in 6 Countries Starting April
updates.summary: Meta adds Location Fees for Digital Service Taxes starting April. Austria 5%, France 3%, Italy 3%, Spain 3%, Turkey 5%, UK 2%.
updates.action: Factor Location Fees into EU/UK budget planning. Adjust CPA targets upward.

updates.title: 5 B2B LinkedIn Ads Tests to Run in 2026
updates.summary: Search Engine Land published a tactical guide: test Document Ads (CPL $38-82 vs $255+ for image), use conversation ads for mid-funnel, try CTV for reach, leverage AI-generated creative variants, and run lead gen with MAX_QUALIFIED_LEAD optimization.
updates.action: Prioritize Document Ads for lead gen. Test MAX_QUALIFIED_LEAD as optimization target. Compare CPL against your current single image ad benchmarks.

updates.title: TikTok New Ownership Rules: First-Party Data Required, AI Endorsements Banned
updates.summary: Under new ownership, TikTok now requires advertisers to use first-party data through Events API, verify business registration, and bans all AI-generated endorsements in ads.
updates.action: Verify business registration in TikTok Ads Manager. Switch to Events API. Remove any AI-generated testimonials from creative.

updates.title: Meta Ad Policy Crackdown: 34% More Rejections in Health/Wellness/Beauty
updates.summary: Meta upgraded multimodal AI enforcement in Q1 2026. New rules on misleading claims, personal attributes, crypto tiers, and diabetes restrictions. Rejection rates spiked 34% in health/wellness/beauty.
updates.action: Audit all health/wellness/beauty ad copy for compliance. Remove before/after language and unsubstantiated claims.

updates.title: Google AI Mode Now Shows Shopping Ads and Sponsored Stores
updates.summary: Google AI Mode (75M+ daily users) now supports shopping ads and sponsored stores inside conversational search. PMax, Shopping, and Search broad match advertisers are automatically eligible.
updates.action: Ensure you run PMax or Shopping with broad match to appear in AI Mode. No separate opt-in needed.

updates.title: Advantage+ Sales Threshold Drops to 25 Conversions/Week
updates.summary: Advantage+ Sales now requires only 25 conversions per week, down from 50. Predictive Budget Allocation reports 8-15% ROAS improvement.
updates.action: Re-evaluate Advantage+ for accounts that previously could not hit the 50 threshold.

updates.title: TikTok NewFronts: 5 New Premium Ad Formats Including Logo Takeover
updates.summary: TikTok unveiled Logo Takeover, Prime Time (3 sequential ads in 15-min window), TopReach (TopView + TopFeed), Pulse Mentions, and Pulse Tastemakers.
updates.action: Consider Logo Takeover or TopReach for product launches. Test Pulse Mentions to appear alongside brand conversations.

updates.title: TikTok Post-Sale: Advertising Questions Remain Despite US Joint Venture
updates.summary: TikTok sealed its US deal but advertisers still face questions: data handling under new ownership, potential ad policy shifts, and whether the platform can regain paused brand budgets.
updates.action: Resume TikTok investment cautiously. Monitor policy changes monthly. Keep contingency budgets on Reels/Shorts.

updates.title: LinkedIn NewFronts: Top Voices 360, CTV via The Trade Desk, Campaign Renaming
updates.summary: LinkedIn announced Top Voices 360 (premium creator sponsorships), a Trade Desk partnership for programmatic CTV ad buying (90% of members watch ad-supported CTV), and renamed Campaign Groups to Campaigns and Campaigns to Ad Sets.
updates.action: Explore Top Voices 360 for B2B thought leadership sponsorships. Test CTV ads via The Trade Desk integration. Update internal docs for the Campaign/Ad Set rename.

updates.title: March Demand Gen Drop: AI Video from Images + Creator Partnerships
updates.summary: Google launched Veo AI video generation from static images for Demand Gen. Creator assets drive 30% conversion lift on YouTube Shorts on average.
updates.action: Test Veo AI video from your best product images. Use creator discovery tool for authentic content.

updates.title: Meta NewFronts: Reels Trend Ads, Creator Discovery, AI Creative Tools
updates.summary: Meta announced ad placements aligned with Reels trends, improved creator partnership discovery, new AI creative tools, and expanded affiliate/in-stream checkout options.
updates.action: Explore Reels trend-aligned placements. Use new creator discovery tools.

updates.title: Google March 2026 Core Update Rolling Out
updates.summary: Google launched its March 2026 core update alongside a spam update. Semrush Sensor reported Very High keyword volatility for nearly the entire month.
updates.action: Do not make reactive SEO changes. Monitor rankings for 2-3 weeks. Focus on content quality and E-E-A-T.

updates.title: WPP Dissolves Holding Company Model: Merges Ogilvy, VML, AKQA
updates.summary: WPP announced Elevate28, consolidating Ogilvy, VML, AKQA, and WPP Media under one structure. Targeting 500M GBP savings by 2028.
updates.action: If working with any WPP agency, expect structural changes. Signals industry shift toward AI-driven operations.

updates.title: TikTok 2026 Rules: Commercial Disclosure Mandatory, Restricted Category Pre-Approvals
updates.summary: Commercial content disclosure is now mandatory for all promotional posts using TikTok's built-in tools. Restricted categories require strict pre-approvals. New Travel Ads solution launched.
updates.action: Ensure all branded content uses TikTok's disclosure tools. Check if your category needs pre-approval.

updates.title: Google Ads Experiments Now Auto-Apply Winning Variants by Default
updates.summary: Google added an auto-apply setting to experiments, enabled by default. Winning test variants roll out to live campaigns without manual review. You pick confidence level (directional, 80%, 85%, or 95%). Only your two chosen success metrics get protected - other metrics can decline unnoticed.
updates.action: Turn off auto-apply for high-spend or complex experiments. Only use it for simple, low-risk tests. Review all metrics manually before applying to critical campaigns.

updates.title: Demand Gen Campaigns Now Require $5/Day Minimum Budget via API
updates.summary: Google enforces a $5 USD daily minimum budget for Demand Gen campaigns created or modified via API (v21+). Existing campaigns below the minimum keep running, but any future budget change triggers the floor. Targets cold-start phase for ML optimization.
updates.action: Check Demand Gen budgets. Any API-managed campaigns below $5/day will error on next edit. Existing campaigns grandfathered until modified.

updates.title: ChatGPT Ads Favor Clarity Over Creativity: 40K+ Placements Analyzed
updates.summary: Adthena analyzed 40,000+ daily ChatGPT ad placements. Average headline: 30 chars, 5 words. Average body: 116 chars, 19 words. Dominant pattern: 'Brand: Benefit' headline. Concrete dollar amounts outperform vague claims. Low-friction offers (free trials) dominate. Tone is calm and conversational, not interruptive.
updates.action: If running ChatGPT ads, lead with brand name + specific benefit. Keep headlines under 30 chars. Use concrete numbers over creative copy. This is a new channel with different rules than Google or Meta.

updates.title: Meta 'Describe Your Audience' AI Targeting: Type a Prompt Instead of Picking Interests
updates.summary: Meta is rolling out a new 'Describe Your Audience' tab in detailed targeting. Advertisers type a natural language description (up to 2,000 chars) of their ideal customer, and AI suggests matching interest/behavior categories. Hovering shows why each interest was matched.
updates.action: Check if the feature is live in your ad sets under Detailed Targeting. Test it alongside traditional interest selection. The AI may surface interests you hadn't considered.

updates.title: LinkedIn Algorithm 2026: Depth of Engagement Over Width of Reach
updates.summary: LinkedIn's 2026 algorithm no longer prioritizes wide reach. It now rewards depth of engagement - meaningful comments, saves, and shares over impressions. Content that sparks conversation in niche professional communities gets amplified.
updates.action: Shift organic and paid strategy from reach metrics to engagement depth. Write for conversation, not views. Niche > broad.

updates.title: AI-Driven Traffic to Retail Sites Up 693% YoY, Ads Entering AI Conversations
updates.summary: AI-driven traffic to US retail websites grew 693% year over year. Ads are now appearing inside AI conversations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode), creating an entirely new advertising ecosystem separate from traditional search and social.
updates.action: Monitor AI referral traffic in GA4. Ensure product/brand data is structured for AI citation. This is the biggest channel shift since social ads.

updates.title: US Influencer Economy Projected to Hit $44B by End of 2026
updates.summary: The Association of National Advertisers reports the US influencer economy will reach nearly $44 billion by year-end 2026. Growing calls for pay transparency and standardized measurement across platforms.
updates.action: Factor influencer marketing into media mix planning. Push for transparent CPM/CPA benchmarks from creator partners.

updates.title: Google Adds Channel Performance Timeline View to Performance Max
updates.summary: Google launched a channel performance timeline view inside Performance Max that shows how Search, YouTube, Display, and other channels contribute to results over time. New investment and performance filters let advertisers spot underperforming channels and rebalance budget.
updates.action: Open any Performance Max campaign and switch to the new channel timeline view. Look for channels eating budget but underdelivering. Use this to push Google for asset-group adjustments or to argue for channel-level guardrails.

updates.title: Amazon Auto-Deducts Ad Costs From Seller Proceeds Starting April 15
updates.summary: Amazon is moving a subset of US advertiser accounts from credit card billing to automatic deduction of ad costs directly from retail sales proceeds, effective April 15. Pay by Invoice (Net 30) and credit cards remain available as alternatives.
updates.action: If you run Amazon Ads in the US, check your billing settings before April 15. Decide whether you want proceeds skimmed automatically or stay on invoice/card for cash flow control.

updates.title: Meta's AI Push Is Reshaping Ad Creation, Buyers Report Mixed Results
updates.summary: Meta is moving aggressively to automate ad creation via Andromeda and Advantage+, with full automation targeted by end of 2026. Media buyers report mixed results and concerns about losing control to 'black-box' systems even as Meta presses forward.
updates.action: Test Advantage+ creative against your manually-built control sets. Track CPA and ROAS side by side. Don't surrender all creative control yet, the automation is uneven.

updates.title: TikTok US Ad Chief Khartoon Weiss Departs Days After NewFronts
updates.summary: Khartoon Weiss, TikTok's North American and global brands and agency lead, announced she will leave the company effective April 9, just days after presenting at TikTok's NewFronts. Her exit continues a pattern of executive turnover in TikTok's ad division over the past two years.
updates.action: If you have a TikTok rep, check whether your account team is changing. Expect roadmap and pricing chatter to slow until the next leader is named.

updates.title: Google Ads Adds 'Results' Tab to Show Real Impact of Recommendations
updates.summary: Google added a Results tab inside the Recommendations feature that shows the incremental impact of automated bidding and budget changes after they're applied. Advertisers can finally check whether a recommendation actually improved performance instead of trusting Google's claim.
updates.action: Before accepting auto-applied recommendations, baseline your account. After applying, open the Results tab and verify the lift was real. Reject recommendations that show flat or negative impact.

updates.title: Google Ads Lets Marketers Reuse AI Text Rules Across Campaigns
updates.summary: Google Ads is rolling out a beta that lets advertisers copy AI text guidelines from existing campaigns and apply them to new ones. The feature reduces rewriting brand rules every time a campaign launches and helps maintain copy consistency at scale.
updates.action: If you run multiple campaigns under one brand, build one master AI text rule set, then clone it across campaigns. Saves hours and prevents drift in tone and disallowed phrases.

updates.title: Google Now Shows Sponsored Ads in the Images Tab on Mobile Search
updates.summary: Google has begun placing sponsored ad units inside the Images tab of mobile search results. Eligible Search and Performance Max campaigns can show without keyword changes, drawing from existing image assets, so advertisers with strong visual creative get the immediate edge.
updates.action: Audit image assets in your top Search and PMax campaigns. Upload more high-quality product/lifestyle images. Visual-first brands should see free incremental impressions on mobile.

updates.title: Google Tests Swipeable Location Carousel in Search Ads
updates.summary: Google is testing an interactive carousel inside search ads that lets users browse and compare nearby business locations directly within the ad unit. Multi-location advertisers gain visibility but also face more in-unit competition.
updates.action: Multi-location brands: confirm location extensions are clean and Business Profile data is accurate everywhere. The carousel will surface whichever locations Google can verify first.

updates.title: Meta Releases Official Google Tag Manager Template for Pixel Setup
updates.summary: Meta launched an official Pixel template inside Google Tag Manager that removes the need for third-party workarounds. The template auto-maps GA4 ecommerce events like purchases and add-to-carts, cutting implementation time and tracking errors.
updates.action: If your Pixel is wired through a custom GTM tag, switch to the official template this week. Cleaner event firing, fewer parity gaps with GA4, less time fixing tracking.

updates.title: Google Rolls Out Onboarding Guide for Universal Commerce Protocol
updates.summary: Google published an onboarding guide for the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) inside Merchant Center, letting merchants integrate checkout directly into AI-driven search experiences and Gemini. This shifts commerce transactions into the search ecosystem itself.
updates.action: Ecommerce brands: review the UCP guide and assess whether your checkout can plug into Gemini-driven shopping. Early adopters will own the AI shopping placements before competitors.

updates.title: Google Launches Centralized Developer Hub for Ads and Measurement
updates.summary: Google introduced a unified Advertising and Measurement Developers Hub, pulling Google Ads API, Google Analytics, AdMob, and Ad Manager docs into one place. The hub consolidates documentation, community channels, and support for technical marketers and dev teams.
updates.action: If your team builds against Google Ads API or GA4, bookmark the new hub. It replaces the scattered doc pages and should save engineers time tracking down API references.

updates.title: 20-30% of Paid Media Spend Is Wasted as CPCs Rise and Budgets Flatten
updates.summary: Account audits show 20-30% of typical paid media spend underperforms while average CPCs continue rising and marketing budgets stay flat. The path to better ROAS is sharper waste detection, funnel-aware budget allocation, and automation paired with human oversight.
updates.action: Run a waste audit on every account this month. Pull search terms, device splits, geo, and dayparting. Cut the bottom 20% by spend that drives no real conversions. Reallocate to proven performers.

updates.title: Marketers Shift Experimental Ad Budgets Away From Meta and Google Toward AI Channels
updates.summary: As performance channels saturate and CPCs climb, marketers are quietly redirecting test-and-learn dollars from Meta and Google toward emerging AI ad surfaces, retail media, and CTV. Economic pressure and AI disruption are pushing brands to diversify before existing channels lose their edge.
updates.action: Carve out 10-15% of your media budget as 'experimental' and split it across ChatGPT ads, Perplexity, retail media networks, and CTV. Treat it as R&D, not performance, and measure incrementality not last-click.

updates.title: Meta's Adaptive Ranking Model Lifts Instagram Ad Conversions +3%, CTR +5%
updates.summary: Meta rolled out an Adaptive Ranking Model on Instagram that processes more engagement signals in real time while reducing system load. Since launching in Q4 2025, Meta reports a +3% lift in ad conversions and +5% lift in CTR.
updates.action: If you run Instagram Reels or Feed ads, expect modest auto-improvement without doing anything. Don't change creative strategy on the strength of this alone, but use it as additional evidence the IG ad system is improving.

updates.title: Retail Media Networks Pitch Beyond Digital Display at IAB NewFronts
updates.summary: Retail media networks like Albertsons Media Collective and Walmart Connect are showing up at IAB NewFronts to pitch full-funnel offerings far beyond digital display. Albertsons highlighted 49.8M loyalty shoppers and a combined offering with Vizio (acquired by Walmart in 2024).
updates.action: If you sell physical product, request a deck from at least one retail media network this month. Their data is closer to the purchase event than any platform you currently buy.

updates.title: Despite Lawsuits and Scrutiny, Advertisers Stay Loyal to Meta and Google
updates.summary: A New Mexico jury ordered Meta to pay $375M for child safety violations and a California jury found both Meta and Google liable for negligence in a $6M verdict. Yet ad spend on these platforms continues at 'almost a shocking level of regularity', with rising AI costs and minor-bans the only real long-term threat.
updates.action: Don't overreact to scandal coverage when planning media. Track regulatory exposure by region (EU and India most active) and have backup plans, but Meta and Google remain dominant for the foreseeable future.

updates.title: Canva Acquires Simtheory and Ortto to Push Into AI and Marketing Automation
updates.summary: Canva announced dual acquisitions of Simtheory and Ortto, framing them as a bet on agentic AI, data infrastructure, marketing automation, and customer engagement. The move pushes Canva from design tool toward an end-to-end marketing platform competing with HubSpot, Klaviyo, and Adobe.
updates.action: If you use Canva at scale, expect deeper marketing automation features in the next 6 months. Watch for native send/email/CRM hooks that may replace current point tools.

updates.title: TikTok Launches Wix Integration for SMB Brands With Pixel + Events API + Catalog Sync
updates.summary: TikTok rolled out a global Wix integration that lets SMB ecommerce brands link their storefront directly into TikTok Ads. Bundles TikTok Pixel, Events API, and product catalog sync. TikTok cites a 19% lift in incremental events and 15% improvement in CPA from early ad partners.
updates.action: If you run a Wix store, install the updated TikTok Ads app from the Wix App Market this week. Wire the Pixel and Events API through the official integration so your tracking is clean before scaling spend.

updates.title: Google Ads Simplifies Enhanced Conversions Into a Single Toggle
updates.summary: Google is consolidating enhanced conversions for web and leads into one unified system with a single on/off switch. Advertisers can now send user-provided data through website tags, Data Manager, and API simultaneously without choosing one method. Existing users auto-migrate starting June 2026.
updates.action: Review your enhanced conversions setup. If using separate web/leads configs, prepare for automatic migration in June. New users can enable at account or conversion action level.

updates.title: Merchant API Lands in Google Ads Scripts, Content API Sunsetting Aug 18
updates.summary: Google is launching Merchant API in Google Ads Scripts starting April 22, replacing the Content API for Shopping which sunsets August 18. The new API features modular architecture, faster updates, and introduces Product Studio API for generative AI capabilities.
updates.action: If you use Content API in Scripts, start migrating to Merchant API before the August 18 sunset. Test the new modular endpoints after April 22 launch.

updates.title: Google Retail Playbook: Product Feeds Now Power CTV, AI Mode, and Demand Gen
updates.summary: Google Ads Decoded reveals product feeds now power multiple retail surfaces including shoppable CTV and AI Mode, delivering a 33% conversion uplift for Demand Gen campaigns. Lookalike audiences function as signals rather than hard targeting boundaries. Advertisers should prepare for Universal Commerce Protocol infrastructure.
updates.action: Ensure product feeds are optimized across all attributes. Test Demand Gen with product feeds for the 33% uplift. Start preparing for UCP rollout.

updates.title: Meta Advantage+ Automation Making Manual Campaigns Harder to Justify
updates.summary: Meta Advantage+ automated systems now handle targeting and delivery so effectively that manual campaign setups are becoming harder to justify for most advertisers. Creative quality and conversion data are now the primary levers advertisers control, not audience selection.
updates.action: If still running manual targeting, test Advantage+ side-by-side. Shift focus to creative quality and conversion signal strength as your competitive edge.

updates.title: TikTok Data: Emotional Connection Now Drives Purchase Decisions Over Production Quality
updates.summary: TikTok purchase data shows emotional resonance, not polished production, is the primary driver of buying decisions on the platform. Relatable, authentic content consistently outperforms professional-grade ad creative in conversion metrics.
updates.action: Prioritize relatable, emotionally resonant creative over high-production assets for TikTok. Test UGC-style content against polished brand ads to validate.

updates.title: Creator Marketing Shifts From Impressions to Real Performance Metrics
updates.summary: Brand-creator partnerships are rapidly shifting from vanity metrics like impressions and reach to measurable outcomes: conversions, revenue, and ROAS. Brands now expect creator content to drive actual business results, not just awareness.
updates.action: Renegotiate creator contracts with performance clauses. Implement proper attribution for creator-driven traffic. Benchmark creator CPA against paid channels.

updates.title: Google Changes Budget Pacing Rules for Campaigns With Ad Schedules
updates.summary: Starting June 1, Google Ads will pace budgets to spend the full monthly amount (30.4 times daily budget) regardless of how many days a campaign is eligible to run. Advertisers using limited ad schedules will see accelerated spending on active days unless they re-tune.
updates.action: Audit every campaign with an ad schedule before June 1. Reduce daily budgets in proportion to the number of active days, or expect overspend. Watch dayparting tests closely after the change goes live.

updates.title: Google Rolls Out Three Agentic AI Safety Features in Ads Advisor
updates.summary: Google added Real-Time Policy Reviews (in-workflow flagging during campaign edits), 24/7 security monitoring with personalised dashboards, and instant certifications to Ads Advisor. The features are English-only at launch with more languages coming.
updates.action: Look for the new safety surface inside Ads Advisor and adopt early on accounts that have had policy or trust issues. Use Real-Time Policy Reviews to catch violations before submission instead of after disapproval.

updates.title: Meta AI Business Assistant Goes Generally Available to All Advertisers and Agencies
updates.summary: Meta moved its AI Business Assistant out of beta to all advertisers and agencies across major global markets. Early users reported a 20 percent higher rate of resolving account issues and a 12 percent decrease in cost per result after applying its recommendations.
updates.action: Open Ads Manager and start using the AI Business Assistant on disabled accounts, payment errors, and underperforming campaigns. Track CPR before and after applying its recommendations to validate the 12 percent claim on your own data before scaling adoption.

updates.title: TikTok Expands Brand Safety and Measurement Coverage to Search, Smart+ and TikTok Lite
updates.summary: TikTok widened its measurement partnerships with IAS, Zefr, and DoubleVerify, with coverage now reaching Search ads, Smart+, GMV Max, and TikTok Lite formats. DoubleVerify also became the first vendor MRC-accredited for TikTok video viewability.
updates.action: If you have paused TikTok testing on brand safety grounds, revisit Search and Smart+ now that third-party measurement is live. Add IAS or DoubleVerify tags to all new TikTok campaigns going forward and benchmark IVT against your Meta and YouTube buys.

updates.title: LinkedIn Launches Off-Platform Event Ads for External Webinars and Livestreams
updates.summary: LinkedIn rolled out Off-Platform Event Ads, letting marketers run Event Ads that link directly to third-party webinar platforms, landing pages, or livestream sites without a native LinkedIn Event page. Global rollout completes by May 6 and supports awareness, engagement, traffic, and lead gen objectives. Performance stays trackable in Campaign Manager.
updates.action: B2B teams running webinars on Zoom, ON24, or Goldcast should switch to Off-Platform Event Ads instead of generic Single Image Ads. Use the event-specific CTA and accelerated delivery to spike registrations in the final 7 days before the event.

updates.title: OpenAI Launches CPC Ads in ChatGPT, Shifting From Pure Impression Pricing
updates.summary: OpenAI started testing cost-per-click ads in ChatGPT, with early reports placing clicks in the 3 to 5 dollar range. The shift gives advertisers a performance-based pricing option alongside the existing CPM-based units and lands ChatGPT closer to direct competition with Google Search ads.
updates.action: If you tested ChatGPT ads on a CPM basis and gave up, retest on CPC where you only pay for clicks. Benchmark CPCs against Google Search brand and non-brand. Build a one-page test plan now so you can move quickly when access opens to your account.

updates.title: Q1 2026 Ad Spend Report: YouTube Up 20 Percent, Facebook Only 4 Percent
updates.summary: Tinuiti's Q1 2026 report covering over 4 billion dollars in annual digital ad spend shows double-digit growth across YouTube, Google Search, and Amazon Sponsored Products, with Facebook a notable laggard at only 4 percent growth. Instagram pulled ahead inside Meta, with Reels driving nearly a third of impressions and 28 percent year-over-year investment.
updates.action: If your Meta budget is still 70 percent Facebook, rebalance toward Reels and Instagram given the impression and growth gap. Recheck YouTube share of your video budget. Treat Amazon Sponsored Products as a search competitor, not a side bet.

updates.title: Netflix Pitches Dynamic Ad Insertion for 2027 Women's World Cup
updates.summary: Netflix is offering advertisers dynamic ad insertion for its 2027 Women's World Cup broadcast. Buyers are cautiously interested but flag concerns over high CPMs and technical scalability for live streaming.
updates.action: If you are a sports or DTC advertiser, ask Netflix for early access pricing now and request audience composition data before committing. Compare CPMs against YouTube live and Amazon Prime sports inventory before locking spend.

updates.title: Webby Winners Show Brand Creative Now Pulls From Internet Culture, Not Onto It
updates.summary: Webby Media Group's executive director Jesse Feister highlighted a shift in the 2026 winners: brands are drawing creative inspiration from internet and creator culture and using physical real-world activations to spark online conversation, rather than pushing brand content onto the web.
updates.action: Audit your creative briefs for net-new branded ideas vs creator and culture remixes, and skew toward the latter for testing. Plan at least one real-world activation per quarter that is designed to be filmed and reshared on TikTok and Reels.

updates.title: Google Ads API v24 Adds CartDataSalesView, 9 New Lead Gen Conversion Types, Retail Filters
updates.summary: Google released Google Ads API v24 with the new CartDataSalesView resource (track what products customers actually buy, not just clicked), nine new lead gen conversion type enums across GA4 and Firebase, tag-based retail filter targeting for Shopping campaigns, view-through conversion optimisation for Demand Gen and App, and gender exclusions for Performance Max.
updates.action: Brief your dev or agency PPC team to map the new lead gen conversion enums to existing CRM and form events. For ecommerce, test gender exclusions on PMax where they are commercially appropriate. Add CartDataSalesView to your weekly product-level reporting once the upgrade is live.

updates.title: Google Ads API to Expand Product Reporting on June 15 to Cover Video, Demand Gen, App, and Full PMax Network
updates.summary: Google announced the Ads API will add cost and conversion metrics to product-level reporting for Video, Demand Gen, and App campaigns from June 15, plus complete network coverage for Performance Max. Backfill is not retroactive: requests for dates before the launch will not contain the expanded data.
updates.action: If you run product-level dashboards (Looker Studio, BigQuery), schedule a refresh of API queries for June 15. Capture a clean cutover snapshot so post-June data can be benchmarked. Tell agency reporting teams ahead of time so they don't misread the historical gap.

updates.title: Alphabet Q1 2026: Google Network Ad Revenue Falls 4% While Search and YouTube Climb
updates.summary: Alphabet reported Q1 2026 revenue of 109.9 billion dollars, up 22 percent. Google Search hit 60.4 billion (up 19 percent) and YouTube ads 9.88 billion (up 11 percent), but Google Network advertising fell 4 percent to 6.97 billion as AI Overviews and agentic surfaces resolve queries inside Google rather than sending traffic to publishers.
updates.action: Reconsider any heavy reliance on Display Network and AdSense placements for performance buys. Brief teams that the Search slowdown narrative is wrong (Search up 19 percent), but the long open-web monetisation story is genuinely cracking. Add YouTube to the must-test list if it is missing.

updates.title: PayPal Launches Curated Ads, Bringing Transaction-Linked Attribution to CTV
updates.summary: PayPal unveiled Curated Ads, a CTV measurement and audience platform that uses PayPal transaction data to build segments and tie streaming ad exposure to actual sales. Launch partners include Warner Bros. Discovery, Tubi, and Spectrum Reach.
updates.action: Direct response brands testing CTV should request access via WBD or Tubi inventory. Compare PayPal-attributed conversions against your existing MMM or Innovid measurement before reallocating budget. Treat as one more data partner, not a single source of truth.

updates.title: WPP Integrates Google Earth AI Into WPP Open for Geospatial Media Planning
updates.summary: WPP plugged Google Earth AI into its WPP Open marketing platform, combining satellite imagery with AI reasoning for geospatial intelligence. Use cases shown include weather and traffic-aware insurance campaigns and media buying optimisation for EV markets.
updates.action: If a client is location-sensitive (insurance, retail with footfall, EV, real estate), ask their agency whether they have access to WPP Open Earth AI or a comparable Esri or Foursquare layer. For DIY teams, replicate the principle by overlaying weather and footfall data manually on your geo bid adjustments.

updates.title: HubSpot April 2026 Developer Rollup: Legacy CRM Card Migration Tool, Client Secret Rotation, Custom Channels API
updates.summary: HubSpot's April 2026 developer changelog landed: a Legacy CRM Card View Swapping Tool to migrate deprecated cards to UI Extension App Cards (deadline Oct 31, 2026), client secret rotation directly inside the developer platform UI (no support ticket needed), and Custom Channels API gains explicit contact association and sender attribution on outgoing messages.
updates.action: If a client uses Legacy CRM Cards, schedule the migration before October. If you manage HubSpot apps, rotate client secrets via the new UI immediately. For Custom Channels integrations, update outgoing message handlers to leverage the new attribution fields.

updates.title: Microsoft Advertising Launches Self-Serve Negative Keyword Lists for Performance Max
updates.summary: Microsoft launched self-serve negative keywords for Performance Max in February 2026, with Editor, API, and Google Ads import support reaching general availability in the March 2026 product update. Lists support up to 5,000 negative keywords with Exact and Phrase match types, applied at campaign or account level.
updates.action: If you run Microsoft PMax, add a negative keyword list mirroring your Google Ads brand-protection negs. This puts Microsoft ahead of Google PMax (which still blocks campaign-level negatives in standard UI). Use the Google Ads import to copy your existing list.

updates.title: Microsoft April 2026 PMax Update: Google Ads Import, Final URL Reporting, 400-Char Names, RSA AI Assets
updates.summary: Microsoft's April 2026 product roundup ships PMax import from Google Ads (incl. NCA goals + automatic audience conversion), Final URL landing-page reporting for PMax, seasonality adjustments for portfolio bid strategies, campaign name limit raised to 400 chars (parity with Meta and Google), AI-generated text assets for underoptimised RSAs, and direct Merchant Center store name and domain edits.
updates.action: Migrate eligible Google PMax campaigns into Microsoft using the new import path. Turn on Final URL reporting on existing PMax to find leaky LPs. Audit any RSAs with under 8 user-supplied headlines for AI auto-asset opportunities.

updates.title: Microsoft Launches AI Max for Search, Offer Highlights, Copilot Checkout, Universal Commerce Protocol
updates.summary: On Apr 21 Microsoft unveiled an agentic-web ad stack: AI Max for Search (open pilot in May, expanded query matching, asset personalisation, smarter URL routing), Offer Highlights (selling points surfaced inside AI conversations on Copilot/Bing chat), Copilot Checkout for in-Copilot purchases, AI Visibility tracking inside Microsoft Clarity, an AI-powered Audience generation tool, and Universal Commerce Protocol support.
updates.action: Audit Microsoft Ads accounts for AI Max readiness: tighten asset feeds, verify Final URL templates, and opt into the May open pilot. Add AI Visibility tracking to standard Clarity dashboards for Microsoft Ads clients. Brief Offer Highlights tests (free shipping, returns, financing) into your roadmap.

updates.title: Amazon Ads Launches Cross-Account Reach and Frequency Reporting Across Sponsored Ads + DSP
updates.summary: Amazon Ads launched cross-account de-duplicated reach and frequency reporting on Apr 2, combining Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP investments into a single unified view. Available across 36 markets in NA, SA, EMEA, and APAC via the Reporting (beta) UI and the public reporting API. Frequency-group measurement now extends to manager-account and cross-manager-account level.
updates.action: Ecommerce clients running both Sponsored Ads and DSP should pull the cross-account R&F report monthly to identify wasted overlap. Replace your old siloed Sponsored vs DSP reach decks with this single unified view in client reporting.

updates.title: Amazon DSP Omnichannel Metrics Adds Product Category Breakouts
updates.summary: Amazon DSP's Omnichannel Metrics now provides product category-level breakouts for US advertisers using a new exposure-based methodology. Multi-category sellers can see which product categories their DSP campaigns drive purchases in, at both study and campaign level.
updates.action: Multi-category advertisers (apparel, beauty, home, etc.) should reallocate DSP budget based on category-level OCM data instead of blended ROAS. Add the category breakout to monthly reporting.

updates.title: Reddit Launches Collection Ads, Deal Overlays, and Shopify Integration at Shoptalk Spring 2026
updates.summary: Reddit unveiled Collection Ads (lifestyle hero image + shoppable product tiles in a single DPA carousel) plus Community and Deal overlays surfacing native Reddit signals. The Shopify alpha integration automates catalogue and pixel setup. Early Collection Ads adopters saw 8 percent lift in ROAS; Reddit DPA drove 91 percent higher YoY ROAS in Q4 2025.
updates.action: DTC and ecommerce clients with a Shopify store should join the Reddit Shopify alpha to remove the catalogue-setup friction. Add Collection Ads to existing DPA campaigns and watch the lift.

updates.title: Reddit Q1 2026: Ad Revenue Up 74% to $625M, DAUs Hit 126.8M
updates.summary: Reddit reported Q1 2026 ad revenue of $625 million, up 74 percent year-over-year. Global daily active users grew 17 percent to 126.8 million (53.5 million in the US). Performance is now 60 percent of total ad revenue, driven by the Reddit Max AI optimisation suite and Dynamic Product Ads.
updates.action: Reddit has graduated from experimental channel to performance contender. Add it to the test plan for any client with intent-driven communities (DTC, B2B SaaS, niche services). Start with Reddit Max + DPA when catalogue is ready.

updates.title: Home Depot's Orange Apron Media Adds Self-Serve Reddit Buying Inside Orange Access
updates.summary: Home Depot's retail media network Orange Apron Media announced at its third annual InFronts an industry-first self-service integration that lets advertisers launch Reddit campaigns directly inside Orange Access using The Home Depot's first-party audience data. Display geotargeting is live now, with expansions through 2026.
updates.action: Brands selling on Home Depot or in adjacent home-improvement categories should test the OAM-Reddit self-serve path for first-party-data-fuelled Reddit reach. Compare ROAS against direct Reddit Ads with similar audience inputs.

updates.title: Google Ads Enforces $5 Daily Minimum Budget for Demand Gen Campaigns from April 1
updates.summary: Google Ads began enforcing a $5 USD (or local equivalent) daily minimum budget for all Demand Gen campaigns from April 1, 2026, applied universally across Google Ads API versions. Existing under-threshold campaigns can keep running but become subject to the new rule on any budget or schedule change.
updates.action: Audit any client running Demand Gen with daily budgets under $5. Either consolidate, raise the budget, or migrate to a different campaign type before the next budget edit triggers the floor.

updates.title: Meta Q1 2026: $55B Ad Revenue Up 33%, 8M Advertisers Now Use AI Creative Tools
updates.summary: Meta reported $55.02 billion in advertising revenue for Q1 2026, up 33 percent year-over-year. Ad impressions rose 19 percent and average price per ad increased 12 percent. AI creative tool adoption doubled to over 8 million advertisers (from 4 million at end of 2024); video generation features showed a 3 percent gain in conversion rate at scale.
updates.action: Meta's AI creative tools are now mainstream, not experimental. Make Advantage Plus video generation a default test on every new campaign for clients that aren't already using it. Use the 33 percent rev growth as evidence for clients hesitating to up Meta spend.

updates.title: HubSpot Spring 2026 Spotlight Launches AEO, Smart Deal Progression, Customer Agent + 100 Updates
updates.summary: HubSpot's Spring 2026 Spotlight on Apr 14 introduced HubSpot AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation, $50/mo standalone or in Marketing Hub Pro+ tracking ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity citations), Smart Deal Progression (analyses call transcripts to draft CRM updates and follow-ups), and Customer Agent (resolves around 70 percent of support conversations independently at $0.50 per resolution).
updates.action: B2B clients on HubSpot with a content engine: add HubSpot AEO so you can show citation share inside ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity in monthly reports. For high-volume support teams, pilot Customer Agent on common ticket types.

updates.title: Snapchat Launches AI Sponsored Snaps - Brand AI Agents in the Chat Tab
updates.summary: Snapchat rolled out AI Sponsored Snaps on Apr 28: brand AI agents placed directly inside the app's main Chat tab where users can ask questions and get product recommendations. Builds on existing Sponsored Snaps which deliver 22 percent more conversions at 20 percent lower CPA per Snapchat. Q1 2026 saw 950 billion chats sent on Snapchat.
updates.action: Brands with strong product Q&A surface area (beauty, electronics, fashion fit) should pilot an AI Sponsored Snaps agent. Treat as an evergreen channel between campaign flights, not a campaign add-on.

updates.title: Pinterest Launches Promote a Pin and Tests Performance+ Catalog Sales via Shopify
updates.summary: Pinterest launched Promote a Pin on Mar 24 - a low-friction boost feature using its Taste Graph multimodal AI to target conversion-likely audiences. Also testing a pre-built Performance+ Catalog Sales campaign that merchants can launch directly from the Pinterest Shopify app or Ads Manager.
updates.action: Small-business and DTC clients on Pinterest can use Promote a Pin to boost top organic Pins without building campaigns. For Shopify-merchant clients, plug the catalogue into Performance+ for hands-off catalogue sales.

updates.title: OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Pilot Crosses $100M Annualised Revenue in Six Weeks
updates.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT advertising pilot crossed $100 million annualised in six weeks of launch, driven largely by FOMO from brands like Williams-Sonoma and DSW rather than proven returns yet. Industry observers caution that focusing on generative engine optimisation may currently outperform paid ChatGPT inventory.
updates.action: If a client wants to test ChatGPT ads, frame it as a learning agenda not a performance allocation. Run small CPC budgets in parallel with a serious GEO push (clean structured data, brand citations, content fit for LLM answers).

updates.title: Creator Ad Spend Growing 4x Faster Than Rest of US Media Industry
updates.summary: Marketing Brew interview with Tiffany Rivers (VP, emerging media and influencer marketing, Media Cause) cites US creator ad spend growing four times faster than the rest of the media industry. Most nonprofit and mid-market clients are still in the experimentation phase, allocating 5-10 percent of paid media budgets to creator partnerships.
updates.action: Push clients still under 5 percent creator allocation to test a structured creator pilot in Q2-Q3. Build creator measurement around outcomes (signups, donations, ROAS) not just engagement.

updates.title: Marketers Pump Brakes on Meta Fully-Automated Ad Vision
updates.summary: Marketing Brew finds advertisers worried about losing creative control and legal risk from undisclosed AI-generated imagery as Meta plans fully automated ad creation by end of 2026. While Andromeda and Advantage Plus are widely tested, many advertisers prefer manual oversight despite pressure to adopt.
updates.action: When pushing Advantage Plus or Andromeda to clients, build a manual creative review gate into the workflow. Document AI-generated assets so the legal and disclosure trail is clean before any platform mandates it.

updates.title: Google Ads PMax Asset-Level A/B Testing Goes GA, AI Max Graduates From Beta
updates.summary: Google made Performance Max asset-level A/B testing generally available in April, allowing advertisers to test individual creative assets against each other inside live PMax campaigns. AI Max also graduated out of beta with universal text guidelines, improved targeting and creative quality, and more advertiser controls.
updates.action: Run a structured asset A/B test on at least one PMax campaign per client this month - start with headlines or images. Migrate any AI Max test campaigns from beta to standard once feature parity is confirmed.

updates.title: Google Ads BatchJobService Quadruples Request Size Limit to 41.94 MB
updates.summary: The Google Ads API BatchJobService increased the AddBatchJobOperations request size limit from 10.48 MB to 41.94 MB. Bulk asset uploads (especially images and videos) can now be done in fewer requests.
updates.action: Update bulk-upload tooling and feed managers to use the larger limit for fewer round-trips on heavy creative pushes.

updates.title: Google Universal Commerce Protocol Adds Cart, Catalog, and Identity Linking
updates.summary: Google updated its Universal Commerce Protocol with a Cart option to save and add multiple items, a Catalog capability for real-time product detail surfacing, and Identity Linking that preserves loyalty benefits across surfaces and platforms.
updates.action: If you operate a Merchant Center or DTC catalogue, brief your dev team on the UCP additions. Identity Linking is the most valuable for retention-focused brands - check that loyalty IDs are mapped correctly.

updates.title: Demand Gen Adds Commerce Media Suite Support and View-Through Conversion Optimisation
updates.summary: Google added Demand Gen support inside Commerce Media Suite plus view-through conversion optimisation specifically for YouTube traffic in Demand Gen campaigns. This connects creative + audience signals across YouTube, Discover, and Gmail with retail-grade optimisation.
updates.action: Brief any retail or DTC client on the new VTC optimisation for YouTube Demand Gen. Test against your current Demand Gen build using a side-by-side experiment.

updates.title: Google Shoppable CTV Goes Fully Live in Demand Gen
updates.summary: Google's Shoppable CTV format moved from limited rollout to fully live in Demand Gen campaigns, letting viewers click product elements during streaming inventory.
updates.action: Ecom clients running Demand Gen should test Shoppable CTV with their top SKUs. Measure incremental revenue against standard YouTube buy on the same audience.

updates.title: Meta Announces AI-Enhanced Pixel and One-Click Conversions API Setup
updates.summary: Meta announced AI-enhanced Meta Pixel automation (auto-adds product and business info into pixel signals) plus a one-click no-code Conversions API setup. The CAPI feature is server-side, includes built-in deduplication, and ships with the 17.8 percent lower cost-per-result claim Meta made earlier.
updates.action: For every client still on Pixel-only, schedule a one-click CAPI setup this week. Re-run a CPR baseline 2 weeks after to validate the 17.8 percent claim.

updates.title: Meta One-Click Conversions API Goes Live to All Advertisers
updates.summary: Meta's free, one-click CAPI setup went live globally on Apr 27, accessible inside Events Manager with no developer required. The Meta-enabled CAPI runs server-side with auto-deduplication and applies to web events.
updates.action: If you skipped the Apr 15 announcement, do not skip the live release - turn on one-click CAPI for every Meta client this week. No reason left to run Pixel-only.

updates.title: Meta Tests Carousel Ads, Advantage+ Catalog Ads and Advantage+ App Ads on Threads
updates.summary: Meta is testing three new ad formats on Threads: Carousel Ads, Advantage+ Catalog Ads, and Advantage+ App Ads. Threads now has 400+ million MAUs and supports Threads-only ad targeting plus Instagram-and-Facebook account-based ad publishing without a Threads profile.
updates.action: Brands without a Threads profile but a Meta presence: test running Threads ads in your next campaign as a discovery placement. Catalog and App formats hit feature parity with IG/FB.

updates.title: Meta Adds Reply Moderation to Threads Ads
updates.summary: Meta rolled out a reply moderation tool for Threads ads, letting advertisers view, hide, and respond to top-level replies on their ad creatives. Requires specific permissions in Business Manager.
updates.action: Assign reply moderation permissions to a community manager for any Threads campaign that risks spam or off-brand replies, especially for B2B and regulated industries.

updates.title: Microsoft + Publicis Expand Strategic Partnership for Agentic Marketing - 114K Employees on Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft and Publicis Groupe expanded their decade-long partnership to build an AI-powered marketing solution combining Microsoft cloud and AI with Publicis transformation expertise and Epsilon identity data. Publicis will deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot to all 114,000+ employees and serve as Microsoft's global media agency of record.
updates.action: If a client uses Publicis or Epsilon, expect tighter Microsoft + agentic-marketing integration in their stack. Track for spillover effects on programmatic supply.

updates.title: Reddit Reminder Ads Go Global - 21% Higher CTR, 3.1x CTR Lift in Early Campaigns
updates.summary: Reddit made Reminder Ads available to all advertisers globally on Apr 13. Tap a Remind Me button on the ad to schedule a notification (24h before + when the event begins) plus calendar add. Reddit reports 21 percent higher CTR on Traffic objectives vs standard image ads, with early campaigns seeing 3.1x lift.
updates.action: For any time-sensitive launch (event, drop, premiere), test Reminder Ads alongside standard image ads. The notification path is free incremental reach. Measure the 21 percent CTR lift on your own data.

updates.title: Magnite Launches Buyer Agent Plus SpringServe AI Mediation - Disney, Kepler, MiQ Test First
updates.summary: Magnite unveiled an AI-powered buyer agent (in test with Kepler and MiQ on Disney Advertising inventory) and added agentic AI mediation features inside SpringServe (anomaly detection, demand path optimisation, dynamic pricing). Publicis Media Exchange and Spectrum Reach are also collaborating.
updates.action: If a client uses Disney CTV or Magnite supply, ask the agency about access to the buyer agent. For SSP-side teams, Magnite mediation tests are worth piloting on premium video inventory.

updates.title: IAS Launches Total TV - Show, Genre, Rating Visibility for CTV Advertising
updates.summary: Integral Ad Science launched IAS Total TV on Apr 27, bringing show, program, genre, rating, and language-level transparency to CTV advertising plus device, viewability, and IVT verification. Available across Disney, NBCUniversal, Paramount, Prime Video, and opted-in Publica publishers.
updates.action: If a client buys CTV, layer IAS Total TV verification on their next flight. Compare the show-level breakdown against the agency's blended dashboard - it almost always reveals waste.

updates.title: Microsoft Ads January 2026 Roundup: PMax NCA Beta, Share-of-Voice Metrics, RSA Autogenerated Assets +5% CTR
updates.summary: Microsoft's Jan 2026 product update opened Performance Max New Customer Acquisition goals in beta, added share-of-voice metrics (impression share, click share, share lost to budget/rank), raised search themes limit from 25 to 50, made Audience Ads content targeting GA, expanded location targeting + Google import reliability, and turned on RSA autogenerated assets globally with a reported 5 percent CTR lift.
updates.action: Run a NCA test on a top PMax campaign for any client trying to grow logo count. Add the new SOV metrics to monthly reporting. Audit RSAs that opted out of autogenerated assets to see if the 5 percent CTR lift would apply.

updates.title: Microsoft Ads February 2026: PMax NCA Goes GA, Negative Keywords Open Beta, Google Account Sign-Up
updates.summary: Microsoft moved Performance Max New Customer Acquisition goals from beta to GA in February. Self-serve PMax negative keywords entered open beta. Audience Ads got an enhanced ad preview hub for site/device/asset previews and shareable preview links. New advertisers can sign up using their Google credentials.
updates.action: Convert any beta NCA test to GA settings. Add PMax negative keyword lists today (mirror your existing Google list). Use the new preview hub for stakeholder approvals before going live.

updates.title: Microsoft Shopping Campaigns Add Multi-Image Listings (Up to 10 Product Images)
updates.summary: Microsoft added multi-image functionality to Shopping campaigns on Bing search results, supporting up to 10 product images per listing via the additional_image_link product feed attribute.
updates.action: Update Microsoft product feeds to include additional_image_link variants for top SKUs. The richer listing typically lifts CTR and conversion rate vs single-image baselines.

updates.title: Amazon Implements Shopping-Signal Enhanced Attribution Model, Tightens View Credit
updates.summary: Effective Jan 1, 2026 Amazon implemented a new shopping-signal enhanced attribution model affecting Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP. View-based conversion credit is now concentrated on real brand-discovery moments using shorter attribution windows. Legacy metrics remain available via an 'all views' reporting option for historical comparison.
updates.action: Recompute every Amazon ROAS baseline post-Jan 1 against the new model before reporting performance to clients. Use the 'all views' option only for backwards comparison, not for new optimisation calls.

updates.title: Amazon DSP Expands Dynamic Reach and Frequency to Custom Cross-Campaign Reporting
updates.summary: In February Amazon expanded dynamic R&F reporting with custom cross-campaign de-duplicated breakdowns by advertiser account, supply source, and frequency group. Flexible time granularity options were added including custom periods, available via the API and UI.
updates.action: Use the new custom cross-campaign R&F reporting for upper-funnel buys to identify duplicate exposure across Sponsored Brands and DSP. Replace any siloed reach reports in client decks.

updates.title: Amazon Ads Launches Unified Inventory Management API in Open Beta
updates.summary: Amazon Ads launched unified inventory management APIs in open beta in March 2026, consolidating deals, proposals, and inventory groups under the API v1 model. Catch-Up Boost field was removed from the UI on March 23.
updates.action: Brief your dev or DSP partner on the v1 API consolidation. Migrate any v0 integrations before deals/proposals/inventory APIs are merged into the standard surface.

updates.title: Reddit Launches Max Campaigns at CES - Automated AI Buying With 17% Lower CPA, 27% More Conversions
updates.summary: Reddit unveiled Max Campaigns at CES January 2026: an AI-powered automated buying tool that handles targeting, bidding, creative selection, placement, and budget. Powered by Reddit Community Intelligence + Top Audience Personas reporting. Early testers saw 17 percent lower CPA and 27 percent more conversions vs business-as-usual campaigns.
updates.action: For any Reddit client, request Max Campaigns access (still beta-gated). Use Top Audience Personas to surface Reddit-native segments your CRM does not capture. Expect this to become Reddit's default in 2026.

updates.title: Reddit Launches Interactive Ads (Games, Quizzes, Dynamic Content) - Paramount, EA, Red Bull as Early Testers
updates.summary: Reddit, with Webflow, launched Interactive Ads in late 2025 enabling games, quizzes, and dynamic in-feed brand experiences. Early adopters: Paramount Pictures (Running Man movie escape game), Electronic Arts (Battlefield launch challenge), Ad Council, Red Bull. Early data showed 11 percent more sales versus standard Reddit ad units in test campaigns.
updates.action: If a client's audience is community-active (gaming, entertainment, sports), pitch an Interactive Ad concept for the next launch. The format is in limited alpha but rolling out to all managed advertisers through 2026.

updates.title: Google Ads Cuts Granular Data Retention to 37 Months Starting June 1
updates.summary: Google announced May 1 that the Google Ads API, scripts, and Analytics Data API will only return granular daily/hourly/weekly data for the last 37 months from June 1. Reach and frequency drop to 36 months. Monthly and yearly aggregates remain at 11 years. DV360 and CM360 are unaffected.
updates.action: Before June 1: export any year-over-year analyses or long-window training data you rely on (especially for budget pacing models and seasonality benchmarks). Pull a clean BigQuery snapshot of pre-2023 daily data NOW, store it in cold storage, and stop relying on the live API for anything older than 3 years. Update internal scripts that query 36+ month windows to fail gracefully.

updates.title: OpenAI Builds EU Compliance Infrastructure for ChatGPT Ads Launch
updates.summary: Code updates to OpenAI's conversion pixel reveal EU-specific infrastructure: upfront consent management, advertiser action exclusions, and a country jurisdiction field. Pixel ships managed-service only (no self-serve yet). The live US pilot is also expanding to Canada, Australia and New Zealand.
updates.action: If you run brands across EU and US, plan for ChatGPT ads as a real channel within 3-6 months. Start tagging conversion events with consent-state metadata so the same tracking model works for both regions. Watch the managed-pilot waitlist - early access is the moat here while supply is throttled.

updates.title: TikTok Adds Manual Keyword Management for Uploads
updates.summary: TikTok rolled out manual keyword management on top of automatic tagging on May 1. Creators can review auto-assigned keywords during upload, remove irrelevant terms, and add their own. TikTok Studio surfaces popular search terms before posting. Mirrors YouTube's tag system.
updates.action: Brief social teams to manually tag every brand upload (organic and paid creator content) with 5-10 high-intent search terms drawn from TikTok Studio inspiration. This is free reach for TikTok-as-search behaviour. Audit recent posts and add keywords retroactively where the platform allows it.

updates.title: Pinterest Launches "Anti-Social Media" Brand Campaign Across TV, Cinema, OOH
updates.summary: Pinterest's first major brand campaign of 2026 launched May 1 across TV, cinema, OOH and digital, telling viewers to put down social media and live their lives. The pitch positions Pinterest as the antidote to AI-flooded Meta and TikTok feeds.
updates.action: Pinterest is making a credible bid to be the brand-safe, intention-rich alternative to Meta and TikTok. Worth reopening the channel for any client where the buyer plans purchases (home, wedding, beauty, parenting, B2C SaaS with visual product). Run a 4-week brand-lift test with shoppable Pins before the H2 budget round.

updates.title: Week of May 4 Marketing Brief: Meta Overtakes Google, IAB $294.6B, AI Mode 93% Zero Click
updates.summary: Five trends crystallised the week of May 4: Meta projected to overtake Google in 2026 worldwide ad revenue ($243.46B vs $239.54B). IAB pegs 2025 US digital ad spend at $294.6B with social up 32.6% and search only 11%. AI Mode hits 1B+ queries/month, 93% zero-click. Creator economy on track for $44B.
updates.action: Three immediate moves: (a) Reweight 2026 media plans toward Meta - growth differential is now 24.1% vs Google 11.9% so the channel CAC math has shifted. (b) Treat AI Mode citations like SEO - audit which client URLs Google is citing in AI answers and feed that into the content roadmap. (c) Convert the largest creator project into a 12-month always-on contract instead of campaign-by-campaign briefs.

updates.title: Google Ads API v20 Sunsets June 10 - All Requests Will Fail
updates.summary: Google reminded advertisers that API v20 sunsets June 10 2026. After that date all v20 requests fail, breaking automated reporting, bidding scripts, and campaign management workflows still on the old version. Migration to a newer version is mandatory before the deadline.
updates.action: Audit every script, bidding tool, and reporting integration for the API version it calls. Anything still on v20 must migrate before June 10. Highest risk: agency reporting dashboards, custom bidding scripts, and any Looker Studio/BigQuery pipeline using the legacy version.

updates.title: X Rebuilds Entire Ad Platform From Scratch - 20-Year First
updates.summary: X confirmed a ground-up rebuild of its Ads Manager, the most significant overhaul in the company's 20-year history. New platform runs on xAI retrieval and ranking systems and shipped in phased rollout from April. Three pillars: simplicity, control, AI-powered performance.
updates.action: Reopen the X test for any client where the audience skews male, tech, finance or political. The xAI ranking layer is genuinely new. Run a 4-week 5K test against a Meta-comparable audience and compare CAC before scaling spend or ruling it out.

updates.title: Bauer Study: 96% of Advertisers Back Audio But Spend Gap Persists
updates.summary: A Bauer Media study released May 3 found 96% of advertisers cite confidence in audio (podcasts, digital radio, streaming) yet audio still captures a fraction of total ad budget. Gap reflects measurement limitations and inertia rather than channel performance.
updates.action: If a client has zero audio in the mix, run a small podcast-host-read test (£2-5K) against the strongest Meta cold-traffic audience. Use a unique URL or vanity code so attribution is clean. Audio is the most under-priced reach channel right now per advertiser sentiment.

updates.title: Ad Blockers Are Selling User Browsing Data - 80+ Chrome Extensions, 6.5M Users
updates.summary: PPC Land reported May 4 that 80+ Chrome ad-blocker extensions, with 6.5 million combined users, legally sell user browsing data to third parties. The disclosure is buried in privacy policies. Marketers gain a counter-narrative on ad-blocker virtue while raising fresh concerns about data marketplaces.
updates.action: Use this in any client conversation framing ad-blocker users as privacy-pure. The data shows otherwise. For brands worried about brand safety on data brokers: audit which DSPs and DMPs source from ad-blocker telemetry and exclude where possible.

updates.title: AI Search Shift: Brand Authority Now Beats Topical Authority
updates.summary: Search Engine Land published May 4 that AI systems prioritise brand mentions and visibility over the breadth of topical coverage that won classic SEO. Authority signals shape which sources get cited in AI answers. Companion pieces released the same day cover 7 tools for AEO and citation tracking.
updates.action: Reweight content roadmaps: fewer topic-cluster pillar posts, more high-quality citations and brand mentions on authoritative sources. Add an AEO tool to every SEO-active client (track which queries cite the brand in ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews) and report citation share quarterly.

updates.title: ChatGPT Ads Launches Self-Serve Manager With CPC Bidding
updates.summary: OpenAI opened a self-serve ads manager for ChatGPT with CPC bidding, campaign tools, and improved measurement, lowering the entry bar for SMBs.
